body:
## Pull request overview

This PR standardizes UI styling and interaction patterns across ObjectUI-rendered surfaces (layout shell, sidebar navigation, list/grid/report views, and config panels) by aligning them to shared theme tokens and consistent micro-interactions.

**Changes:**
- Replace multiple hardcoded grays/rounded-md usages with theme tokens and rounded-lg across runner/plugins/fields.
- Improve navigation and view chrome (sidebar active indicator + tooltips, tightened tab bar with active indicator, ListView toolbar inline search + active button states).
- Add shared global styling hooks (Inter font on `:root`, `--config-panel-width`, separators between config sections) and document the work in ROADMAP.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 15 out of 15 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/runner/src/LayoutRenderer.tsx | Use theme background token for the app shell. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/ReportRenderer.tsx | Tokenize report container/table styling and standardize radius. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/components/TabBar.tsx | Tighten spacing and add active-tab indicator + transitions. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx | Update tests for always-visible inline search input. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Inline search input, active-state styling for toolbar buttons, overflow handling. |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/VirtualGrid.tsx | Unify header background + header typography tokens. |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | Tokenize loading/empty styling and gray fallback badge styling. |
| packages/layout/src/SidebarNav.tsx | Provide tooltip text to sidebar menu buttons (for collapsed mode). |
| packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx | Tokenize grid field table styling and standardize radius/hover. |
| packages/fields/src/index.tsx | Add `formatRelativeDate()` and support `formatDate(..., 'relative')`. |
| packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx | Sidebar group separators + active indicator + transition updates. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx | Unify table header styling with muted header background and typography. |
| packages/components/src/index.css | Add `--config-panel-width` and set global `font-family` on `:root`. |
| packages/components/src/custom/config-panel-renderer.tsx | Use `--config-panel-width` and add section separators. |
| ROADMAP.md | Document the UI consistency milestone and status. |
</details>

The row hover style uses `transition-colors` without a duration class, so the transition duration will default to 0s. If you want the intended 150ms hover transition, add `duration-150` (to match the rest of the UI consistency changes).
```suggestion
              <tr key={rowIdx} className="hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors duration-150">
```

The doc comment mentions an "Overdue 3d" output, but formatRelativeDate() never returns an "Overdue"-prefixed string. Either adjust the comment to match current behavior or implement the overdue formatting described.
```suggestion
 * Format date as relative time (e.g., "2 days ago", "Today", "In 3 days")
```

Section separators are keyed off the original section index (sectionIdx). If earlier sections are hidden via visibleWhen, the first visible section can incorrectly render with a leading <Separator>. Track the index of the last rendered/visible section (or filter visible sections first) before inserting separators.

The active indicator bar uses ::before utilities, but no `before:content-["" ]` (or equivalent) is set. Without a content value, the pseudo-element won’t render, so the 3px active indicator may never appear.
```suggestion
    "data-[active=true]:before:h-4 data-[active=true]:before:w-[3px] data-[active=true]:before:rounded-full data-[active=true]:before:bg-primary data-[active=true]:before:content-['']",
```

Switching the active tab adds a real bottom border only for the active state, which can cause a 2px layout jump when changing tabs. Consider reserving the space by applying `border-b-2 border-transparent` for inactive tabs (and only changing the border color when active).
```suggestion
                : "border-b-2 border-transparent text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
```

This input has `transition-colors` but no `duration-*` class, so the color transition duration remains the CSS default (effectively no animation). If the goal is consistent 150ms transitions, add `duration-150` here as well.
```suggestion
                className="pl-7 h-7 text-xs bg-muted/50 border-transparent hover:bg-muted focus:bg-background focus:border-input transition-colors duration-150"
```
